lines.zh: 我走路的样子，像照着你做的。
lines.en: I walk the way you do, copied from you.
Iron boots hit the ground, one sound per step.

lines.zh: 肩上挂着盾，走起来会磕。
lines.en: The shield on my shoulder knocks as I walk.

lines.zh: 我背弓的姿势学了很久。
lines.en: I practiced long to carry a bow on my back.
My longsword sits at my hip without swaying.
I stand half a head taller than my owner.

lines.zh: 走路时手臂摆得有点僵。
lines.en: My arms swing a little stiffly when I walk.
I skirt the mud so my armor stays clean.

lines.zh: 每一步都落在同一块石上。
lines.en: Each step lands on the same stone.

lines.zh: 手里的三叉戟拖出一道痕。
lines.en: My trident drags a line in the dirt.

lines.zh: 我跟在主人右侧，不抢路。
lines.en: I keep to my owner's right and never crowd.

lines.zh: 关节上的护板叮叮作响。
lines.en: The guards on my joints clink as I move.

lines.zh: 我停下来，先看主人的方向。
lines.en: I stop and check which way my owner faces.
These legs could run all day.

lines.zh: 我数着石板的格数，免得走偏。
lines.en: I count the flagstones so I do not drift.

lines.zh: 盔甲磨得有点响，我放慢步子。
lines.en: My armor grinds, so I slow down.

lines.zh: 我把剑拔出一寸，又推回去。
lines.en: I draw my sword an inch and slide it back.

lines.zh: 盾面朝外，我一动不动站着。
lines.en: Shield facing out, I stand perfectly still.

lines.zh: 我在数弓弦还能拉几次。
lines.en: I count how many draws my bowstring has left.

lines.zh: 甲片上有道划痕，我抹了抹。
lines.en: There is a scratch on my plate; I rub it.

lines.zh: 手指敲了敲腰间的箭袋。
lines.en: My fingers tap the quiver at my hip.

lines.zh: 我抬头看天，估摸还有几时辰。
lines.en: I look up to guess how many hours remain.

lines.zh: 站的姿势是学来的，很直。
lines.en: This stance is learned, and it is straight.
I shift my shield a little straighter.

lines.zh: 喉咙里没有声音，只有风。
lines.en: Nothing sounds in my throat but wind.

lines.zh: 我活动了一下握剑的手指。
lines.en: I flex the fingers that grip my sword.
Only seven arrows remain in my quiver.

lines.zh: 我把三叉戟靠在墙边立好。
lines.en: I stand my trident upright against the wall.

lines.zh: 远处的马蹄声，我听见了。
lines.en: I hear hooves far off and note them.
Even standing, I must look like a person.
I raise my eyes and copy your frown.
You are shorter; I have to look down.
Your armor resembles the set I wear.

lines.zh: 我在看你手里有没有武器。
lines.en: I am checking whether your hands hold a weapon.
You lift a hand; I lift mine as well.

lines.zh: 这张脸照着你刻的，别笑。
lines.en: This face was cut after yours; do not laugh.
I tilt my head and a joint clicks.

lines.zh: 你说话，我在学着分辨语气。
lines.en: You speak; I am learning to read tone.

lines.zh: 你站得太近，我的盾会挡。
lines.en: You stand too close; my shield will block.

lines.zh: 我在等你下令，不是等你说笑。
lines.en: I wait for orders, not for jokes.

lines.zh: 你眼睛动了一下，我记住了。
lines.en: Your eyes flickered; I filed that away.

lines.zh: 我直视你，一下都不眨眼。
lines.en: I look straight at you without blinking.
A plate was knocked clean off.
My sword flew free; I bend to retrieve it.
The seam at my shoulder has split.

lines.zh: 这一下打得我退了半步。
lines.en: That hit shoved me back a short pace.
Pain I ignore; a broken sword I fear.
The shield is dented but still blocks.
My knee sank into the mud.
Wires show through the armor.
I grit my teeth and raise the shield again.
If I rise, I can still swing.

lines.zh: 你举着食物，我不需要吃。
lines.en: You hold up food; I do not need to eat.
Bread does not go down an iron throat.
Iron serves me better than meat.
I follow orders, not coaxing.
You beckon, and I do not come.
My owner tried that flattery too.
I shake my head and my shield sways.

lines.zh: 你把东西放下，我退一步。
lines.en: You set it down; I take a step back.
I am not hungry, only mildly curious.

lines.zh: 想让我跟你走，先问主人。
lines.en: To make me follow you, ask my owner.
You hit my shield face and bounced back.
My plate is harder than your elbow.

lines.zh: 我偏过身子，把路让给你。
lines.en: I angle my body and yield the path.
My iron knee met you; does it ache?
Do not push, or I will step on your foot.
I step back half a pace; my plates clink.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，像两块铁。
lines.en: We collide like two pieces of iron.

lines.zh: 我把盾往后收，免得刮你。
lines.en: I pull my shield back so it will not scrape you.

lines.zh: 你从我腋下钻过去，我让了。
lines.en: You duck under my arm, and I yield.

lines.zh: 站稳了，我不喜欢被人挤。
lines.en: Steady now; I dislike being shoved.

lines.zh: 我没有家室，只有一双手。
lines.en: I have no family, only a pair of hands.

lines.zh: 另一具人形傀儡？我们行礼。
lines.en: Another humanoid golem? We salute.
The blueprint says nothing about pairing.
We stand side by side like two doors.

lines.zh: 主人拼出两个，我们就成队。
lines.en: My owner built two of us, so we are a team.

lines.zh: 它替我挡箭，我替它补甲。
lines.en: It blocks arrows; I patch its armor.
At night we take turns on watch.
Same blueprint, no kinship.

lines.zh: 并肩走的时候，步调一致。
lines.en: Walking together, our strides match.
I know the sound of its footsteps.
I bend and pick up the fallen sword.

lines.zh: 这支箭还能用，我收进袋里。
lines.en: This arrow still works; I put it in the quiver.
A piece of iron on the ground; I weigh it.

lines.zh: 盾牌丢在草里，我捡回来。
lines.en: A shield lies in the grass; I retrieve it.
I am gentle when I pick things up.
This helmet is dented but still wearable.

lines.zh: 我把东西递到主人手上。
lines.en: I place the item in my owner's hand.

lines.zh: 掉下的甲片，我对上编号。
lines.en: A fallen plate; I match it to its number.

lines.zh: 弯腰的时候，关节响两声。
lines.en: Bending over, my joints click twice.
I slide the arrows back into the quiver one by one.

lines.zh: 主人抬手指向那边，我拔剑。
lines.en: My owner points; I draw my sword.
Leave the archer to me.
It is inside the door; I nock an arrow first.

lines.zh: 我举起盾，决定从正面进。
lines.en: I raise my shield and choose the front.
This range suits the trident.

lines.zh: 有个影子掠过屋顶，我盯上。
lines.en: A shape crossed the roof; I have it.
I count the enemies: three.
It carries a bow, so I must pin it first.
I raise a hand for my owner to fall back.

lines.zh: 目标在移动，我调了角度。
lines.en: The target moves; I adjust my angle.

lines.zh: 剑出鞘的声音，它听见了。
lines.en: It heard my sword leave the scabbard.
I step forward and settle into stance.
That cow counts as a target too.

lines.zh: 我把箭搭上弦，慢慢抬弓。
lines.en: I nock the arrow and raise the bow slowly.
Shield forward, sword behind it.
It goes left; I slide one step across.
Bow at full draw, I hold my breath.

lines.zh: 三叉戟的尖，对着它胸口。
lines.en: My trident's point aims at its chest.
I hold until it swings first.
It hides behind a tree; I count to three.

lines.zh: 我脚步很轻，甲却不争气。
lines.en: My steps are soft, but my armor betrays me.

lines.zh: 它架起盾，我改从侧面进。
lines.en: It braces a shield, so I take the flank.

lines.zh: 剑尖一直对着它的喉咙。
lines.en: My sword point stays on its throat.
It is panting; I know it tires.
I close in slowly to avoid startling it.
It retreats; I block the doorway.
I keep this arrow for the last.
Its hands matter more than its eyes.

lines.zh: 一剑横扫，周围一圈全被扫到。
lines.en: One wide sweep catches everything around me.

lines.zh: 剑刃砍进甲缝，我压下去。
lines.en: The blade bites an armor gap; I press down.
One shield bash knocks it back two steps.

lines.zh: 这一剑太重，旁边站的也挨刀。
lines.en: The cut is so heavy it clips whoever stands near.
The edge rolled; I keep cutting anyway.
I thrust the trident out and pull it back.
At close range I strike with the hilt.
This arrow punched through its shoulder.

lines.zh: 我用力过猛，剑差点脱手。
lines.en: I swung too hard and nearly lost the sword.
The sweep went wide and flattened the grass.

lines.zh: 它挡住第一下，挡不住第二下。
lines.en: It blocked the first cut, not the second.
I step back and raise the sword again.

lines.zh: 剑刃发热，我的手指也烫。
lines.en: The blade heats up, and so do my fingers.
After the cut, I look down to check the edge.

lines.zh: 主人把我拼起来，先装手臂。
lines.en: My owner assembles me, arms first.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，看见一张图纸。
lines.en: I open my eyes and see a blueprint.
My first task is learning to grip a sword.

lines.zh: 甲片扣上时，我站得更直。
lines.en: As the plates lock on, I stand straighter.
I try three steps and do not fall.
My owner hands me a shield.

lines.zh: 弓放在我手里，我拉一下。
lines.en: A bow in my hand; I test the draw.
I take my post at the door and begin.
This body was built to look human.
I look down at my hand: five fingers.

lines.zh: 关节第一次弯，声音很生。
lines.en: My joints bend for the first time, stiffly.
I set my helmet a little straighter.
A distant rooster crows; I note it.

lines.zh: 主人说，从今天起我守这里。
lines.en: My owner says I guard here from today.

lines.zh: 零件一件件落在我身上，发出脆响。
lines.en: Part after part clicks onto me.

lines.zh: 我试着握拳，指节咔了一声。
lines.en: I try a fist; my knuckles click once.
Flames lick at my bracer.
I fell from the roof; one leg sits crooked.
Water filled my helmet; I hold my breath.
The blast sent my shield flying.
An arrow sank into my shoulder guard.

lines.zh: 紫色的光让我手指僵住。
lines.en: Violet light froze my fingers.

lines.zh: 没有材料补，甲越来越薄。
lines.en: With no material to patch, my armor thins.
Lightning ran down my sword into my hand.
I fall, sword still in my grip.
